card: Introduces a BlockTemplateManager and adds a MempoolUpdated validation interface signal carrying fee rate diagram chunk changes. Currently, waitNext repeatedly acquires cs_main and constructs full block templates every tick solely to determine if fee increases justify a new template. By tracking fee-rate diagram deltas across mempool updates, waitNext detects staleness without redundant block assembly. Mining helper functions and block submission are also centralized into the manager.
changed_since_previous: The prior dependency #35675 was merged upstream; this branch remains to be rebased on top of it.
evidence: PR description: 'Currently, to decide whether mempool fee inflow rose enough to be worth a new template, waitNext locks cs_main and assembles a full block template every tick just to sum its fees and compare. After cluster mempool... we shouldn\'t have to build a whole block template to answer that question.'
PR description links to Delving Bitcoin research: 'determining-blocktemplate-fee-increase-using-fee-rate-diagram/2052'.
Author notes the fuzz harness for the new manager uncovered a miner chunk-limit check bug fixed in merged PR #35580.
problem: To check whether newly arriving transactions justify issuing a fresh block template, `waitNext` in the IPC mining interface repeatedly acquires `cs_main` and builds complete block templates solely to sum and compare their fees. Additionally, mining utility functions are free functions scattered across `miner.cpp` requiring manual threading of dependencies, and `SubmitBlock` allocates a throwaway validation listener on every block submitted.

risk.why: Mistakes in mempool chunk fee tracking or validation signal ordering could cause mining clients to stall, miss profitable transactions, or encounter deadlocks.

scope_notes: About half of the patch (+1090 lines) consists of tests, including a new fuzz harness for `BlockTemplateManager` and unit tests in `mempool_update_tests.cpp`. The manager refactor was originally split into #35675 (now merged), and this branch retains the commits up through fee-inflow tracking.
summary: Consolidates block template creation, waiting, and submission helpers into a `BlockTemplateManager` class registered with validation signals. Adds a `MempoolUpdated` validation interface event that tracks before-and-after fee rate diagram chunks with transaction references. Leverages these diagram snapshots to monitor mempool fee inflow per active template, replacing the polling loop in `waitNext` that assembled full blocks on each tick.
